scope: fully synthetic DraftKings Hits forward-shadow adapter check
success_conditions: one synthetic official MLB target is derived at exactly T-4h
one provenance-valid prediction snapshot and one raw-provider-bound hard quote produce one immutable target receipt
the receipt can produce one ledger entry only through an exact quote hash and the same policy hash bound by the capture plan
one raw-provider-bound close and one official final outcome produce one immutable linked resolution
the verified ledger produces a shadow-only per-market capture report
failure_conditions: any post-target model, quote, capture, or ledger append is accepted
a missing or fabricated market side is accepted
an ambiguous game, player, quote, or final market is silently selected
a mismatched plan, policy, config, prediction, raw provider, close, or official outcome artifact is accepted
a close outside entry_quote <= close_quote < official_start is accepted
a report authorizes betting or pools a different market
protected_invariants: GitHub is not the primary collector
provider raw bytes and independently resolved identities remain hash-bound
the selected side is predeclared by a policy artifact and is never inferred from row order
the ledger remains append-only and shadow-only
required_mutations: close for a different market key
